# CASE py_dup_plain expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        log(await step(item), await step(item))
# CASE py_dup_two_strings expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        log(await step(item), "a", await step(item), "b")
